operations.description:
Returns URLs pointing to images in JPG format in the highest available resolution (depending on the component) of the vehicle's:
  * engine (1024x576 px), 
  * rim (710x710 px), 
  * trim (800x600 px), 
  * paints (800x600 px), 
  * upholstery (800x600 px) and 
  * equipments (740x416 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components [PATH] components [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] array code components equipment image map paints response url

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of the vehicles engine.  These images are available in the resolution 1024x576 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components engine [PATH] components engine [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] engine image response url

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicle's equipments. The images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 740x416 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components equipments [PATH] components equipments [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] array equipment image map response url

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicles paint.  These images are available in resolution 800x600 px.  Note there might be two paints (e.g. Smart, 'paint' for body panel and 'paint2' for the tridion cell)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components paint [PATH] components paint [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] code image paint paints response

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of the vehicles rim.  These images are available in the resolution 710x710 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components rim [PATH] components rim [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] code image response rim

operations.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of this vehicles trim.  These images are available in resolution 800x600 px.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components trim [PATH] components trim [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] code image response trim

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of the vehicle's upholsteries. Tge images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 800x600 px).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image components upholstery [PATH] components upholstery [PARAMS] finorvin [SCHEMA] code image response upholstery

operations.description: Returns URLs pointing to PNG images of a vehicle with a transparent background.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] image vehicle [PATH] vehicle [PARAMS] finorvin night open perspectives roof [SCHEMA] error image response url vehicle with
